tips.text: Pledge Perrin or New Loka first; the other rises alongside at half rate, so buy the Blade and Handle together.
Switch to Hexis or Cephalon Suda only after buying the Blade and Handle; parts you bought stay in your inventory.
Pair Hexis with Cephalon Suda; pledging either one raises the other.
Do not try to hold all six syndicates; opposing factions eat most of the standing you earn.
Players find the syndicate juggling annoying but not painful; Centaur is slow and item-hungry.
